mstts:express-as.prosody: Imagine settling into a train seat, the world sliding by outside your window—city skylines giving way to wild jungles, quiet villages, and the wide-open plains of a continent on the move. That’s the spirit at the heart of our journey together, inspired by Paul Theroux’s unforgettable adventure, The Old Patagonian Express: By Train Through the Americas. We’re about to trace a path from the familiar streets of Boston all the way down to the wild, windswept edges of Patagonia. Each stop along the way, we’ll discover new rhythms, meet fellow travelers full of stories and quirks, and watch as the landscape—and the very idea of what it means to travel—shifts right before our eyes. What if every meal shared, every conversation overheard on the rails, drew us closer to the heart of the Americas? We’ll laugh at the chaos of border crossings, pause for the quiet moments when the world feels huge and unknown, and find ourselves wondering about the ties that connect us all. So, welcome aboard—let’s see where this train will take us. Together, we’ll explore not just the places on the map, but the sense of adventure, curiosity, and connection that makes every journey unforgettable.
